steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each scope item, price and term is matched to the standard terms or an approval.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 term is not in the standard terms

findings.title: Term not in the standard terms
findings.fix: Take the term to legal before sending

findings.title: Price differs from the list with no approval
Scope item with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the scope item

outcome.notChecked: Whether the customer accepts; the legal effect of any term.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a price that differs from the list with no approval, a scope item with no source, and a term that is not in the standard terms.
cons: Not checked: Whether the customer accepts; the legal effect of any term.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-proposal skill on the records for this review.
